record.issuing_body: AI organisations that agreed to the commitments (20 by February 2025), announced by the UK and Republic of Korea governments at the AI Seoul Summit; published by the UK Department for Science, Innovation and Technology
record.notes: The UK and Republic of Korea governments announced the first 16 signatories: Amazon, Anthropic, Cohere, Google, G42, IBM, Inflection AI, Meta, Microsoft, Mistral AI, Naver, OpenAI, Samsung Electronics, Technology Innovation Institute, xAI and Zhipu.ai. Magic, Minimax, 01.ai and NVIDIA were added on 7 February 2025, making 20. Signatories undertook to publish a safety framework focused on severe risks by the next AI summit, in France (the AI Action Summit, INT-01), and to provide public updates if their approaches to the three outcomes change.

verification.note: Stored and read: the GOV.UK publication page (official), which gives the first publication on 21 May 2024 and the update of 7 February 2025 that added organisations, and the commitments' HTML text (alt-official), which gives the 20 organisations, the eight commitments under three outcomes and the definitions; both stored 11 Oct 2026 and unchanged on 17 Oct 2026, with no update after 7 February 2025.

judgment.status_reasoning: Voluntary commitments published on 21 May 2024; the publication page lists one update, on 7 February 2025 (organisations added), and the copy re-checked on 17 Oct 2026 shows no later update. 'Published (non-binding, current)' stands.
judgment.summary_check: The summary matches commitments I to VIII: risk assessment across the lifecycle, thresholds for intolerable severe risks, not developing or deploying a model if risks cannot be kept below the thresholds, internal accountability, publication of a safety framework, public transparency and sharing with trusted actors such as home governments.
judgment.scope_reasoning: Company commitments brokered and published by governments; the existing scope_note stands.
